Class FileBrowser

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
net.tessel.fx.components.FileBrowser
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class FileBrowser extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
A file browser pane: breadcrumb address bar (click the empty part to type a path), places sidebar, back / forward / up / new folder, list, details and tile views, extension filters, and a name field. TesselFileChooser puts it in a dialog; it can also be embedded in a window. 
FileBrowser browser = new FileBrowser(FileBrowser.Mode.OPEN_MULTIPLE);
browser.setDirectory(new File(System.getProperty("user.home")));
browser.getFilters().add(new FileChooser.ExtensionFilter("Images", "*.png", "*.jpg"));
browser.setOnAccept(() -> open(browser.resolveResult()));   // double click or Enter
Keyboard: Backspace or Alt+Up goes up, Alt+Left / Alt+Right go back and forward, F5 refreshes, Ctrl+L edits the address, Ctrl+Shift+N creates a folder, Enter opens the selected folder.
